rawReport.fixtureDefinition: No random sampling or seed: fixed midpoint quadrature and stable fixture light UUIDs. Portrait recipe; camera (0,1.60,1.7)m, 85mm full-frame lens, 5600K white balance, +1.25 stops. Point3 uses recipe point emitters. Area3 replaces them with 1x1.2m, 0.8x0.8m and 0.4x0.8m rectangles, 8x8 samples each. Area12 repeats each area light four times at one quarter intensity for cancellation only.
rawReport.methodology: One warm-up per workload; monotonic wall time; nearest-rank p50/p95. Deterministic synchronous CPU renders. Cancellation uses monotonic deadlines in the real callback, not asynchronous UI scheduling. Receiver microbenchmarks omit image/color conversion and primary intersections. Short-run shared-host diagnostics, not physical-device, GPU, thermal, memory or sustained frame-rate evidence.

contractReview.optimization: Actual compile command uses swiftc -O; main rejects debug-assert configuration; raw report optimizedBuild=true.
contractReview.frameMatrix: sphere/bust x point3/area3 x widths 72/144 = 8 workloads; heights 48/96; samples per surface 3 or 192.
contractReview.frameWarmups: One actual warm-up render per frame workload; all eight warmupMilliseconds retained.
contractReview.frameDeterminism: Each of seven measured renders is compared directly to its warm-up StudyImage and must have zero unsupported pixels or benchmark throws. StudyImage contains Data RGBA and validity mask and uses synthesized Equatable. FNV1a64 values identify warm-up frame bytes but are not the sole determinism assertion.
contractReview.visibilityMatrix: point3/area3 x occlusion off/on = four workloads, 34 receivers, 1,000 evaluations per sample. Source performs one untimed operation warm-up before seven measured samples; the JSON does not separately time visibility warm-ups.
contractReview.cancellationMatrix: bust-area3-144 and bust-area12-144 at 5 ms and 25 ms thresholds, three repeats for each combination = 12 probes. All twelve catch StudyError.cancelled, report a callback observation at/after deadline and a preceding false poll before deadline.
contractReview.percentiles: All 12 frame/visibility p50/p95 values recomputed from raw seven-sample arrays using nearest-rank rule; all exactly match. With seven samples the p95 is the observed maximum.
contractReview.noTimingThreshold: Timing is diagnostic and the code acceptance contract sets no portable latency threshold.

efbig.interpretation: Real production ProjectLibraryFileStore.save(candidate,replacing:prior) failed under child-only RLIMIT_FSIZE=32768 with SIGXFSZ ignored only in that child. The helper reset errno before save and captured 27 immediately after throw. The NSError chain contains only generic Cocoa code 512, so the POSIX evidence is the reset/captured errno, not an underlying NSError. Unrestricted control and fresh-process reopen passed; exact prior bytes, active identity and unrelated open/archived records survived.
